desc: Parse H, W, X, P, Q (convert to 0‑based) and the grid S of size H×W.
Create a list of all cells with their strengths, sort ascending; also keep a boolean array `alive` initially False, mark as we process.
Initialize DSU for H·W nodes; for Takahashi's start cell, set its component strength = S[P][Q] and mark alive.

Iterate the sorted cells: for each cell, if it is already alive, skip; otherwise check if any 4‑direction neighbor is alive and its component strength > v·X (i.e., v < comp_strength / X). If yes, union this cell with that neighbor's component and add v to that component's total strength; also mark this cell alive. Repeat merging with any other adjacent alive components whose condition holds.
After processing all cells, output the component strength of the cell (P, Q).
